settings.contextMessageLimitSubtitle: Limit how many history messages are sent to the model
settings.contextMessageLimitNote: When enabled, only the latest N history messages are sent as context. Older messages are ignored. When disabled, there is no limit.
settings.toolCallRoundsLimitSubtitle: Limit tool-call rounds within a single reply
settings.toolCallRoundsLimitNote: When enabled, a single reply may run at most N tool-call rounds; exceeding the limit stops execution. When disabled, there is no limit.
settings.temperatureNote: When enabled, temperature is sent to the model. When disabled, the parameter is omitted and the provider default is used.
settings.topPSubtitleOff: Not set; use the provider default
settings.topPNote: Nucleus sampling threshold. Accumulate tokens from highest probability until this mass is covered, then sample within that set. Range 0–1; 0 means the parameter is not sent.
settings.topKSubtitleOff: Not set; use the provider default
settings.topKNote: Sample only from the top k tokens by probability. Range 0–50; 0 means the parameter is not sent. Some protocols (e.g. Responses) may not support Top-k.
settings.memoryWriteFrequencySubtitle: Control how often memory is auto-generated
settings.memoryWriteFrequencySubtitleOn: Write after $count turns since last memory
settings.memoryWriteFrequencyNote: When enabled, memory updates automatically once N user turns have passed since the last memory message, and a memory message is inserted into the chat. When disabled, memory is not generated automatically.

defaults.appSystem: You are SoulCast's AI chat assistant. Answer concisely and naturally.
defaults.memoryUpdateSystem: You are a conversation memory organizer that must output strict JSON.
defaults.titleSystem: You are a concise conversation title generator. Output only the title text.
defaults.titleUser:
Generate a short title for this conversation.

Rules:
1. Summarize the topic; do not restate the whole user question.
2. Prefer at most 16 Chinese characters or 8 English words.
3. No quotes, book-title marks, colon prefixes, or trailing punctuation.
4. Output only the title; no Markdown or explanation.
5. Use Chinese if the dialogue is mostly Chinese; use English if mostly English.

User message:
{{userText}}

Assistant reply:
{{assistantText}}
defaults.generateCharacterSystem: You are a character-card generator that must output strict JSON. Output one JSON object only; no Markdown, code fences, or explanation.
defaults.generateCharacterUser:
Based on the idea below, generate a complete role-play character card.

Idea:
{{idea}}

Output JSON fields (all strings):
- name: character name (required, max 40 chars)
- description: one-line blurb for lists
- personality: personality, values, and behavior tendencies
- speechStyle: tone, common phrases, self-reference, and how to address the user
- appearance: looks and current presentation
- scenario: opening scene or world background
- greeting: first line in a character chat
- exampleDialogues: sample lines that anchor the voice
- hardConstraints: things the character must never do or say

Requirements:
1. Be concrete and usable for role-play; avoid empty clichés.
2. Keep fields consistent; do not contradict yourself.
3. Infer and fill reasonable details when information is missing.
